claims: Every baseline file tracked at gitHead is reproduced byte-for-byte by "git clone" of this repository into an empty directory. Collaboration records are excluded: they are notes about the baseline, and writing one changes it.
doesNotClaim: Unity editor import, compilation or gameplay launch from the clone. Those need their own recorded run and evidence.
statement: Cursor 在提交 77ad67b 后执行：全仓 clone 对比工作区逐字节一致，用于补全项目 gate 的 cleanGitCheckoutVerified 一项。不声明编译或运行通过。
